title: Behind-wall painted metal chips
change: Add a small cluster of pale paint chips over muted rust on one rear metal panel.
implementation_notes: Use a single compact mask at x>=bx+3; keep chips off the ground plane and use pale gray edges so the panel does not become a dark mass.
capture_safe_reason: The weathering is rear-only, small in area, and value-balanced toward pale chipped paint.
acceptance_test: Harbor remains Usable; the rear panel gains readable paint loss without any new foreground or ocean contrast issue.

title: Fuselage access-panel offset
change: Add one shallow offset border around an existing fuselage access panel behind the wall.
implementation_notes: Use a 1-2 pixel projected border in warm gray; keep the panel face mid-value and avoid adding a full hero decal.
capture_safe_reason: Only a small existing-surface border is added beyond x>=bx+3, with no new dark or reflective material.
acceptance_test: Panel border must be legible in YakBeauty and absent from the frozen foreground overlap; all 11 cameras remain usable.

title: Gunner station trim notch
change: Add one small bright trim notch to the gunner station side panel.
implementation_notes: Use a single trapezoid accent with restrained contrast and no additional panel volume.
capture_safe_reason: A single behind-wall trim notch is a controlled local detail and does not affect canopy, aircraft exterior, or exposure.
acceptance_test: The notch is readable as a manufactured trim cue in Cockpit with no new black block or loss of usability.

title: Compact twin-lobed muzzle flash
change: Add a short-duration, camera-facing twin-lobed muzzle flash proxy to the primary aircraft gun firing point.
implementation_notes: Use a small additive sprite or card, warm white core with restrained amber edge, 0.05-0.09 second lifetime, and bounded size relative to the weapon muzzle.
capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive content stays in the muzzle region and cannot create a dark FOV wall or sun-washout field.
acceptance_test: Capture Combat and ADS; muzzle flash is readable for one burst, occupies less than 3 percent of frame area, and all 11 cameras remain Usable.

title: Single impact ember core
change: Add one compact orange-white emissive ember core at the first hit location.
implementation_notes: Use a small billboard with a brief brightness peak and fast fade; keep the radius below the local panel feature scale.
capture_safe_reason: A single tiny emissive point provides a stable focal cue and cannot obscure the nose or create a smoke wall.
acceptance_test: The ember is visible in PropNose and Combat, remains under 1 percent of frame area, and does not alter silhouette readability.

title: Behind-wall rust tile
change: Add one small rust tile decal/material variation behind the wall on a visible city-side construction surface.
implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3 on an existing wall or utility surface; use a compact orange-brown rust mask with a light base and no foreground overlap.
capture_safe_reason: The authored weathering is explicitly behind the wall and outside the frozen foreground densify band.
acceptance_test: City remains Usable; the rust tile is visible only on the intended rear surface and does not affect Prop, YakBeauty, Ocean, or Wide.

title: Warm brick bay bands on facade tower
change: Add two narrow warm-brick vertical bay bands to facade_tower_proxy with bright unlit height-field breakup.
implementation_notes: Use a small additive proxy offset from the tower face; keep intensity restrained and preserve the existing HF-lit silhouette.
capture_safe_reason: Small bright facade accents preserve the frozen FOV density and avoid dark sole-material coverage.
acceptance_test: Loop52 capture remains 11/11 usable; City and Wide show two readable brick bands without clipping or black patches.
